reason: Both meet all hard requirements, but Response B more concretely satisfies the decommissioning constraint by adding an explicit, separately-gated Phase 4 for legacy decommissioning (with its own 60-day/90-day criteria) rather than just noting it as vaguely 'out of scope' as Response A does, and it pairs this with more varied, well-specified risks (payment tokenization, tax reconciliation, rollback SLA) and halt metrics (invoice discrepancy, payment failure delta, Sev1 attribution).
